name: Counterparty or flows in higher-risk jurisdictions with weak AML controls
description: Funds, counterparties or institutions are located in jurisdictions with weak AML supervision, sanctions exposure or limited VASP regulation.
fp: Customers with genuine ties to such jurisdictions, such as diaspora remittances or aid delivery, produce many alerts.

links.name: Beneficiary account in high-risk or uncooperative jurisdiction
links.ctx: Receiving corridors are known for weak controls or sanctions risk.

links.name: Sanctioned or high-risk jurisdiction counterparties in game economies
links.ctx: Transfers or sales involve users in sanctioned regions, detected via geolocation or wallet data.

links.name: Cash-out in jurisdictions with weak controls
links.ctx: Final withdrawals go to exchanges or accounts in jurisdictions with poor AML supervision or known to shelter cybercriminals.

links.name: Use of non-compliant jurisdictions' P2P channels
links.ctx: Trades routed through P2P markets in jurisdictions lacking VASP supervision.

links.name: Respondent based in high-risk jurisdiction with weak AML supervision
links.ctx: Respondent operates where regulation or supervision is weak.

links.name: Connections to high-risk jurisdictions
links.ctx: Programs in high-risk areas without controls.

links.name: High-risk jurisdiction funds or buyer connections
links.ctx: Funds or buyers come from jurisdictions with weak controls or sanctions exposure.
